entries.answer: I've created a complete single-file HTML clone of the Replit platform UI with a modern dark theme, responsive design, and interactive elements. The page includes a navigation header, hero section, project grid with cards, features showcase, and footer. It features smooth animations, hover effects, and a professional color scheme matching Replit's aesthetic. All functionality is self-contained in one HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript.

Created a complete Replit IDE clone with realistic 2026 interface featuring: top navigation bar, left sidebar with explorer/search/git/debug icons, file tree panel, code editor with tabs and syntax highlighting, and console/output panel with realistic logs. Full dark theme matching Replit's design system with interactive components and responsive layout.
